acceptanceCriteria: Journal metadata matches the committed migration set and numbering is coherent enough for future Drizzle operations. Any renumbering is reflected consistently. Verification commands remain green.

findings.summary: Migration SQL file referenced by journal does not exist on disk
findings.detail: The journal at idx 32 references tag '0031_add_otp_verification_scope', but no corresponding SQL file exists at apps/api/drizzle/0031_add_otp_verification_scope.sql. The consent-schema.ts diff adds a 'scope' text column and 'otp_verifications_scope_idx' index to otpVerifications, so the migration SQL should contain ALTER TABLE and CREATE INDEX statements. Without the SQL file, drizzle-kit migrate will fail when attempting to apply this migration. Either generate it via drizzle-kit generate or create it manually.

findings.summary: No meta snapshot files exist for journal entries 19-32
findings.detail: Snapshots only exist for entries 0000-0004, 0011, 0013, 0015-0018. The 14 newly added journal entries (idx 19-32) have no corresponding snapshot JSON files. While some earlier gaps (0005-0010, 0012, 0014) are pre-existing, the complete absence of snapshots for all new entries may indicate they were never generated via drizzle-kit. Drizzle-kit uses snapshots for diffing when generating new migrations — missing snapshots may break future drizzle-kit generate commands.
